name: @estate/money
description: Exact decimal arithmetic for money and NUMERIC(6,3) percentages, on BigInt. Extracted from the assets service in M10 PR3 when the AI assistant's analysers became the second consumer: an estate cannot be represented in binary floating point, and two services doing that arithmetic from two copies is how the copies diverge. Zero runtime dependencies — money math must not be able to pull a supply chain in behind it.
